webhook.name: Webhook service endpoint
webhook.chooseWhen: a simple HTTPS endpoint you own receives the context; synchronous only when it must be able to cancel the save. Nothing is stored while it is down (60 s time-out, one more try only for 502/503/504)

service-bus-queue.name: Service Bus queue endpoint
service-bus-queue.chooseWhen: one consumer (or a pool of identical ones) must process every message, also after hours offline, with dead-lettering and redelivery

service-bus-topic.name: Service Bus topic endpoint
service-bus-topic.chooseWhen: several independent consumers each need every message, each with its own subscription, pace and dead-letter queue

event-hubs.name: Event Hubs endpoint
event-hubs.chooseWhen: a high-volume, time-ordered stream for analysis or replay; readers keep their own position in consumer groups; no completion or dead-letter per event

flow-trigger.name: Dataverse trigger in a cloud flow
flow-trigger.chooseWhen: no code, a reaction after the commit at low volume, by makers; not for durable delivery through long outages

endpoint-step.name: Step registered on a service endpoint
endpoint-step.chooseWhen: every event that matches message, table and filtering attributes is posted, without code

custom-publisher.name: Custom plug-in with IServiceEndpointNotificationService
custom-publisher.chooseWhen: code must decide whether or where to post, add shared variables, or use a two-way listener's answer; it contains nothing but preparing and posting

change-tracking.name: Change tracking (delta link)
change-tracking.chooseWhen: a consumer keeps its own copy, pulls on its own schedule and needs deletions; only $select, 7-day window

modifiedon-query.name: Query on modifiedon
modifiedon-query.chooseWhen: a one-off list of rows changed since a date where deletions don't matter and $filter is needed; never a synchronisation feed

upsert.name: Upsert (UpsertRequest or keyed PATCH without If-Match)
upsert.chooseWhen: unknown keys should create rows and known keys update them, idempotently; RecordCreated tells which

update-if-match.name: Update-only keyed PATCH (If-Match: *)
update-if-match.chooseWhen: only existing rows may change; an unknown key must give 404 and create nothing

create-only.name: Create-only (If-None-Match: * or Create)
create-only.chooseWhen: seed data that must not overwrite existing rows; an existing key gives 412 or a duplicate-key error

retrieve-then-write.name: Retrieve, then Create or Update
retrieve-then-write.chooseWhen: the write depends on more of the stored row than its existence (for example a status check before an update)

openapi-import.name: Import an OpenAPI definition
openapi-import.chooseWhen: you have an OpenAPI 2.0 file or URL below 1 MB describing the operations you need

github-import.name: Create from the PowerPlatformConnectors repository
github-import.chooseWhen: a connector for the API already exists in microsoft/PowerPlatformConnectors and you want a custom copy

apim-export.name: Create a connector from Azure API Management
apim-export.chooseWhen: the API is published in API Management; create and update the connector from its Power Platform blade

policy-template.name: Policy template
policy-template.chooseWhen: a declarative change of header, query parameter, path or host (GA templates) per operation, no code

custom-code.name: Custom code (Script : ScriptBase)
custom-code.chooseWhen: stateless reshaping of one API's request or response beyond templates; under 2 minutes, 1 MB, listed namespaces, no secrets

function-gateway.name: Azure Function behind the connector
function-gateway.chooseWhen: the logic needs a secret or a grant connectors can't use, several sources, state, logging or private network access

function-key.name: Function key (authorization level Function)
function-key.chooseWhen: a service-to-service call where a shared secret is acceptable and no user identity is needed

easy-auth.name: App Service authentication with Entra ID
easy-auth.chooseWhen: the function must know and authorise the calling user from a validated token (X-MS-CLIENT-PRINCIPAL)
